info.title: MikoshiTracker API v1
info.description: Versioned, self-describing API for MikoshiTracker. Uniform envelope ({ok,data} / {ok,code,error}), typed error codes, paginated lists, and OpenAPI components. Converges with the companion mikoshi /api/v1 conventions so a single frontend or AI tool can consume both.

bearerAuth.description: Personal API token, circle token, or the admin API key, depending on the operation's auth scope.
